title: Peptide Eye Gel-Cream
body_html:
Lightweight vegan peptide eye gel-cream targeting fine lines, dark circles, and puffiness with Acetyl Tetrapeptide-5 and hyaluronic acid. Absorbs fast, sits well under makeup, fragrance-free and caffeine-free.

Key ingredients

  • Acetyl Tetrapeptide-5 — targeted de-puffing peptide; improves microcirculation and fluid drainage
  • Sodium Hyaluronate — plumps fine lines and crepey texture in the thinnest skin on your face
  • Grape Seed Oil — antioxidant-rich, fast-absorbing OPCs
  • Bamboo Extract — natural silica for long-term firmness

How to use

Rice-grain-sized dab per eye, patted in with your ring finger (never rub). AM and PM after serum, before moisturizer. Wait 60 seconds before SPF or makeup.

Who it's for

Moms dealing with morning puffiness, under-eye shadows, or early fine lines — and anyone who finds heavier eye creams cause creasing or milia. Pairs with the PDRN Brightening Serum for a full peptide stack.

Free from

No parabens • No sulfates • No synthetic fragrance • No PEGs • No phthalates • No animal derivatives • No caffeine

Full ingredients

Acetyl Tetrapeptide-5, Sodium Hyaluronate, Grape Seed Oil, Bamboo Extract, Cetearyl Glucoside

1 fl oz (30ml) · Made in USA. External use only; avoid direct contact with eyes; discontinue if irritation occurs.

faq_json.question: How does this pair with your PDRN serum?
faq_json.answer: They're designed to work together. In the morning: apply our Vegan PDRN Brightening Serum to your full face, then follow with this Peptide Eye Gel-Cream on the under-eye area before SPF. At night: cleanser, then PDRN serum on the face, then this eye cream, then Sleep Plus Collagen Cream as your final moisturizer. The PDRN serum's Argireline peptide addresses expression lines broadly, while the Acetyl Tetrapeptide-5 in this gel-cream zeros in on puffiness and dark circles around the orbital area — two different peptide mechanisms, complementary coverage.

faq_json.question: Can I use this during pregnancy or while breastfeeding?
faq_json.answer: We always recommend checking with your OB or midwife before introducing new skincare actives during pregnancy or breastfeeding. The good news: this formula does not contain retinoids, retinol, salicylic acid, hydroquinone, or synthetic fragrance — the ingredients most commonly flagged during pregnancy. It's a short, clean ingredient list with peptides, hyaluronic acid, grape seed oil, and bamboo extract. Your provider can review the full INCI with you to confirm it's right for your specific situation.

faq_json.question: Does it work under makeup?
faq_json.answer: Yes — the gel-cream texture was specifically designed with makeup compatibility in mind. It absorbs quickly and leaves no residue, film, or tackiness that would cause concealer or foundation to crease or migrate. Apply a small amount, pat gently to absorb (about 60 seconds), then apply your makeup as normal. The thin, delicate skin around the eyes is prone to creasing with heavy products — the lightweight gel-cream format avoids all of that while still delivering meaningful hydration and peptide actives.

faq_json.question: How long until I see results?
faq_json.answer: Morning puffiness reduction can be noticeable within the first few uses — Acetyl Tetrapeptide-5 works on fluid dynamics, so some people see improvement quickly. For visible fine line softening and dark circle reduction, consistent use over 4–6 weeks is where most people see meaningful change. Peptide results are cumulative: the longer and more consistently you use the product, the more benefit your skin banks.

faq_json.question: Can I use this AM and PM?
faq_json.answer: Yes, it's formulated for twice-daily use. Morning use helps address overnight puffiness and prepares the eye area before SPF and makeup. Evening use allows the peptides and hyaluronic acid to work overnight while your skin is in repair mode. Using it consistently morning and night is how you'll see the best results for fine lines and dark circles over time.

faq_json.question: What's different about a 'gel-cream' texture?
faq_json.answer: A gel-cream sits between a lightweight gel and a rich cream — it delivers meaningful hydration without the weight or occlusive feel of a traditional eye cream. Standard eye creams can be heavy enough to cause milia (small white cysts) around the eyes or to travel into the eye itself, causing irritation. This gel-cream absorbs quickly, doesn't migrate, and plays nicely under makeup. For the under-eye area specifically — the thinnest, most sensitive skin on your face — that lightness matters.

faq_json.question: Does this contain caffeine?
faq_json.answer: No — our Peptide Eye Gel-Cream does not contain caffeine. Instead, we use Acetyl Tetrapeptide-5, a peptide that targets under-eye puffiness by improving fluid drainage and microcirculation at the structural level. Caffeine is a popular de-puffing ingredient (it works via vasoconstriction), but we chose to formulate with a peptide that supports longer-term improvement in the under-eye area rather than a temporary vascular effect.
